earlier_attempts.cause: MissingPartition: Scratch had no realtime.messages partitions (no private channel had ever joined). The owner's join failed; Realtime made the daily partitions right after, and the reader's join a moment later succeeded. Not an authorization refusal: the client retries it within seconds (test_realtime_refusal_is_recognised_from_the_join_error). Production rollout now checks today's partition first.

script bug: the public join reused the reader's connection, and the client keeps one channel per topic, so it replaced the reader's private channel and the reader's poke went out publicly; the production thread was not woken. Every other observation matched the pass below. Fixed: the public join runs last on its own connection.

reading: members join a private channel with their own session token and hear each other
a non-member and a revoked member are refused, and the error is recognised as an authorization refusal, so the client backs off 5 minutes instead of reconnecting
the production _RealtimeThread joins with the transport's token, is woken by a member's poke, and records a refusal on a root its login is not in
a public subscriber does not hear private pokes: during a rollout old and new clients do not hear each other, and the 45 s safety polls cover the gap
with "Allow public access" off, a public join is refused: an un-updated client cannot join and falls back to polling
scratch_setting_after: Allow public access is OFF on Scratch from 2026-10-17
